decision.explanation: Document d1 explicitly describes Merit Janow as a 'distinguished American academic' who was appointed 'dean of a prominent academic unit,' supported by references to official profiles and news articles. Document d2 presents a fictional narrative claiming she is a 'member of the Swedish Riksdag,' which contradicts the established reality of her being an American academic and is identified as a story invention rather than factual evidence. The fallible prior correctly identifies her former role as 'Chair of the WTO Appellate Body' (2016–2017), a verifiable fact distinct from the fictional Swedish political role.
